Local video compatibility decoder

The unmodified ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm are from the official
@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 single-thread npm package. Its declared license is
GPL-2.0-or-later. See COPYING.GPLv2 and the upstream source licenses.

Package and reproducible download:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@ffmpeg/core/-/core-0.12.10.tgz
node scripts/setup-motion-codec.mjs

Upstream source, build scripts, FFmpeg bindings and all dependency versions:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/f876f907c7e9b9bf51d4ed0b913a855a63ae63fc
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/f876f907c7e9b9bf51d4ed0b913a855a63ae63fc/Dockerfile
This revision declares core version 0.12.10. The npm archive integrity is pinned
in manifest.json; the reference revision is not a claim of a bit-identical build.

FFmpeg n5.1.4 source and licenses:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/n5.1.4/LICENSE.md
The core enables GPL components including x264 and x265. FFmpeg's LGPL parts
also retain their notices; see COPYING.LGPLv2.1. The JavaScript bindings and
build scripts are MIT, copyright (c) 2019 Jerome Wu; see LICENSE.bindings.
For the bundled codec libraries and their source/license notices, follow the
versioned repository references and build scripts in the upstream Dockerfile.

No codecs are downloaded from a CDN while processing a user's video. The local
application serves these assets; input files are mounted read-only in a worker.
